message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Series / Title | Publication Year | Notes |
|----------------|------------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter** (7‑book series) | 1997–2007 | *Philosopher’s Stone* (UK) / *Sorcerer’s Stone* (US) – first book; *Deathly Hallows* – final book. The series follows the young wizard Harry Potter as he battles the dark wizard Voldemort. |
| **Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them** | 2001 | A companion guide to the magical creatures of the Harry Potter world, later adapted into a film franchise. |
| **Quidditch Through the Ages** | 2001 | A fictional history of the sport Quidditch, also part of the Harry Potter universe. |
| **The Tales of Beedle the Bard** | 2008 | A collection of wizarding fairy tales, referenced in *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows*. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel, a political thriller set in a small English town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Debut crime novel under her pseudonym, featuring private detective Cormoran Strike. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Third book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **The Ickabog** | 2020 | A children’s fable published online during the COVID‑19 pandemic. |

These titles cover Rowling’s most well‑known works across both her famous Harry Potter series and her ventures into adult fiction and other genres.
